reason: A heading word ('fruit type', 'inflorescence type'). The value is the noun that follows it (capsule, panicle, spike), which is a bearer, not a quality.
Means forking in two, repeatedly. This matches the previous rule that maps 'dichotomous' to PATO:0001784 bifurcated.
This is the timber's resistance to decay, a property of wood in use rather than a shape or structure. PATO:0001178 'resistant to' needs the agent (fungi, insects), which the floras do not name.
PATO:0002215 falciform lists 'hooked', 'uncinate' and 'unciform' as synonyms. The French 'en forme de crochet' means the same.

label: arborescent
definition: A shape quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its having the form of a tree: a single erect, stout main stem bearing a crown of branches or leaves.
reason: Most statements describe the habit of the whole plant ('tree-like herb'), like the existing FLOPO:0991039 palm-like. Where the bearer is a trichome, 'tree-like' means branched hairs and should map to PATO:0002045 dendritic.
Same reading as the rule for 'obscure' (inconspicuous). The quality belongs to the veins (PO_0005020 vascular bundle) of the named part, entered as the part of the bearer.

label: pseudo-whorled
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a set of leaves or branches by virtue of their being crowded at successive nodes separated by very short internodes, so that they appear whorled although each node bears a single member.
reason: 'Pseudo-' means 'falsely', not 'nearly', so it cannot be PATO:0001951 whorled or an approximate value. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001951 whorled.

label: pandurate
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being fiddle-shaped: oblong or obovate with a concave constriction on each side below the middle.
reason: Neither PATO nor FLOPO has pandurate. The 'sub-' prefix is handled by the approximate value pattern (docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md) on top of the new class.

FLOPO:0991040 claw-shaped already has 'claw-like' as a synonym and covers curved, pointed spines, teeth and stipules. Where the text says a petal is 'narrowed into a clawlike base', the meaning is FLOPO:0991169 clawed.
Subrotund means nearly round in outline, which is PATO:0002397 subcircular (nearly but not perfectly circular).

label: androdioecious
definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a plant species or population by virtue of some individuals bearing only staminate flowers and others only bisexual flowers.
reason: A standard breeding-system term with no class yet. NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991072 dioecious and FLOPO:0991094 andromonoecious.
Hood-like means hood-shaped, which is FLOPO:0991119 cucullate (synonyms hooded, hood-shaped). The French 'en capuchon' means the same.
Exarillate means without an aril: the complement of 'has part some aril'.
This is a count of two bracteoles (PO_0009043) on the pedicel or flower. It needs 'bracteolate → bracteole' added to config/flora_counted_parts.tsv, with 'bi-' read as 2.
A vague count of seeds per fruit or carpel ('seeded → seed' is already in the table). 'Few' has no number, so the statement is held under the count pattern's rule.

FLOPO:0991026 fibrous already has 'stringy' as a related synonym and suits bark that splits into fibres and stringy roots. The single 'stringy latex' statement means viscous and does not fit this rule.
A heading word. The value is the habit term that follows it (cespitose, creeping, suffrutex), which has its own term.
A relation stated without its second term: the part separates from something (mesocarp from the stone, exocarp from endocarp). It belongs to the relation-to-another-part pattern, not to a term.
Tuberiferous means bearing tubers (stolons or rhizomes bearing tubers), the same kind of rule as stoloniferous.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum and transition between two values)
reason: A compound of FLOPO:0991024 ovate and elliptic, plus 'broadly', which describes the width-to-length ratio. It needs no new term.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum and transition between two values)
reason: A compound of oblong and PATO:0001883 clavate, two existing values.
Upswept pinnae and branches are directed gradually upward at an angle, which is PATO:0104355 ascending.
The opposite of the existing 'lenticellate' presence rule.
A degree adverb ('thinly leathery', 'thinly pubescent'). Its meaning depends on the value it modifies, and it is not a quality by itself.

label: saxicolous
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing on rocks or in rock crevices.
reason: A habitat position like the existing FLOPO:0991110 epiphytic and FLOPO:0991111 terrestrial. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (where an organism lives).
The definition of FLOPO:0991053 subglabrous is 'nearly glabrous, retaining only a few or very sparse hairs'.
A loose resemblance (arrested branches, moss perigonia, fruits) with no single shape or structure behind it.

label: faceted
definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface consisting of several flat faces meeting at angles, as in seeds pressed against one another.
reason: PATO:0001977 angular is about salient angles of a margin (2-D), so it does not fit. Faceted seeds and fruits are a common 3-D shape with no term. NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991120 trigonous.
Used both as a noun (a swelling, i.e. a part) and as a verb. 'Swollen' is the form to handle, and PATO:0001851 swollen is a transient abnormal enlargement, so it does not fit.
